title: WashMate
description:
Welcome to WashMate.

When the day starts to feel a little too routine, WashMate keeps you company. Skip the stern little clock. Set WashMate in a corner of your monitor, watch plush friends tumble softly in the washer, and settle into work or study.

• A cozy focus timer
 Set your focus time and let the washer run. Gentle alerts keep you on track without pressure, and without breaking your flow.

• Lovely little plush friends
 The more you work, the more animal friends you meet. Frog, Duck, Rabbit, and Fox are waiting, each with 10 different looks. Every 25 minutes of focus unlocks a new one. You’ll need to unlock every look on the current friend before the next one arrives.
 And then… Hako is just a hamster.

• A natural desktop widget
 WashMate is made to sit quietly in a corner of your screen. While you work toward your goals, it works alongside you and keeps you company.

• A little extra fun: bubble mini-game
 While the washer is running, pop the bubbles that drift up beside the screen. A light bit of fun that won’t pull you out of focus.

• Calm sounds
 Three calm tracks are ready for focus time. When the washer runs, you’ll hear a real washing machine too.

Take a breath, set the timer, and start a calm, productive day with WashMate.
description_short: WashMate is a cozy desktop widget and focus timer for your work and study sessions. Focus on your tasks while enjoying the relaxing view of cute plushies gently tumbling inside a washing machine. Collect adorable animal friends to create your own comfortable and productive workspace.
